{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace JoinContract

inductive Mode where
  | inner
  | left
  | full

inductive JsonVal where
  | null
  | bool (b : Bool)
  | num (n : Nat)
  | str (s : String)
  | arr (xs : List JsonVal)
  | obj (m : List (String × JsonVal))

def keyEq (a b : JsonVal) : Bool :=
  match a, b with
  | .null, .null => false
  | .bool x, .bool y => x = y
  | .num x, .num y => x = y
  | .str x, .str y => x = y
  | .arr x, .arr y => x = y
  | .obj x, .obj y => x = y
  | _, _ => false

def rowKey (r : List (String × JsonVal)) : JsonVal :=
  match r with
  | [] => .null
  | ("key", v) :: _ => v
  | _ :: rest => rowKey rest
  | _ => .null

def solve (left : List (List (String × JsonVal)))
          (right : List (List (String × JsonVal)))
          (m : Mode) : List (JsonVal × JsonVal) :=
  let matchedRight : List Bool :=
    right.map fun r =>
      left.any fun l => keyEq (rowKey l) (rowKey r)
  let leftPart : List (JsonVal × JsonVal) :=
    left.flatMap fun l =>
      let matches : List (List (String × JsonVal)) :=
        right.filter fun r => keyEq (rowKey l) (rowKey r)
      if matches.isEmpty then
        match m with
        | .inner => []
        | .left | .full => [(.null, .null)]
      else
        matches.map fun r => (.obj l, .obj r)
  let rightPart : List (JsonVal × JsonVal) :=
    match m with
    | .full =>
      (List.zip right matchedRight).filterMap fun (r, m) =>
        if m then none else some (.obj r, .null)
    | _ => []
  leftPart ++ rightPart

def valid (left : List (List (String × JsonVal)))
          (right : List (List (String × JsonVal)))
          (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  True

theorem thm_join_correct (left right : List (List (String × JsonVal))) (m : Mode)
    (h : valid left right m) :
    ∀ (l r : List (String × JsonVal)),
      keyEq (rowKey l) (rowKey r) ↔
      (match l, r with
       | [], [] => false
       | ("key", a) :: _, ("key", b) :: _ => keyEq a b
       | _ => false) := by
  sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    ∃ (left right : List (List (String × JsonVal))) (m : Mode),
      valid left right m ∧
      solve left right m ≠ [] := by
  sorry

end JoinContract",
